sources.locator: Overview; Sessions that do not die; Where it runs
sources.finding: Terminals and coding-agent CLIs (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, opencode) as live nodes on an infinite canvas; tmux sessions outlive the app; macOS/Linux desktop primary, Server Edition headless-Linux-to-browser, iOS companion.

sources.title: Agents overview
sources.locator: Built-in agents; Capabilities by agent; Custom agents; How status detection works
sources.finding: Four built-ins (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, opencode) launched as one-shot node startup commands; capability matrix turns features on per agent; custom agents spawn any CLI with process/title status only (no hooks); status via each agent hook posting to loopback HTTP server, no output scraping; hooks no-op outside nodeterm-spawned sessions.

sources.title: Agent status & notifications
sources.locator: RUNNING and NEEDS YOU; Unread and notifications; Session names
sources.finding: Hook events normalized to working/waiting/blocked/done, badged RUNNING / NEEDS YOU; unread dots on node/minimap/tab when unfocused; opt-in OS notifications, click focuses and centers node; Claude node titles track session names bidirectionally until manually renamed.

sources.title: Subagents & loops
sources.locator: Subagent fan-out; Loop, schedule & cron cards
sources.finding: Claude subagents render as ephemeral display-only cards (type, task, state, duration, tokens, tool use; live transcript; cleared next turn/session end). /loop repeats in-session; /schedule and /cron persist across restarts; schedule cards cleared when job deleted.

sources.title: Branch conversations
sources.locator: What branching does; When to use it
sources.finding: Claude-only branch action: sends /branch into the running session and opens a new node resuming the original conversation; both stay live.

sources.title: Context Link
sources.locator: Linking two agents; Linking a note
sources.finding: Edges between built-in agent nodes enable on-demand reads of the linked transcript/summary/output (Claude via skill, Codex/Gemini/opencode via instructions-file note; idle-time pointer). Custom agents and plain terminals cannot be context sources. Sticky-to-terminal links push note text once when idle; note-to-plain-terminal carries no push.

sources.title: Claude accounts
sources.locator: Why multiple accounts; How isolation works; Adding; Choosing per node; SSH projects
sources.finding: Claude-only managed accounts: each gets its own config dir, CLI owns login/credentials, nodeterm only points CLI at the dir (macOS needs CLI >= 2.1); node account fixed at creation, inherited by branch/chat forks; SSH projects list only host-local accounts.

sources.title: Permission modes
sources.locator: Modes; Global setting and per-project override; Version compatibility
sources.finding: Claude-only terminal-node starting modes: manual, auto (default, needs CLI >= 2.1.71), acceptEdits, plan, bypassPermissions (travels via project file with a warning); Shift+Tab cycles live; chat nodes use in-conversation cards instead.

sources.title: Chat nodes
sources.locator: What a chat node is; Permissions in chat; Queueing and stopping; Continuity; Forking from a terminal
sources.finding: Claude-only SDK-driven chat nodes: token streaming, thinking blocks, slash-command popup, image paste/drop, cost chip, in-conversation Allow/Always-this-session/Deny cards, queued messages, Stop interrupt, resume from saved session id across restarts; terminal-to-chat fork is experimental.

sources.title: Source control
sources.locator: The panel; AI commit messages; Scopes

sources.title: Team access & presence
sources.locator: What Team Access is; Inviting; Presence; Working together; Managing seats
sources.finding: Share this Mac canvas with equal peers: seats $5/seat/month, identity = device, 6-digit mutual security-code handshake + explicit shell-access approval, per-seat grant; live cursors in peer colors, cursor chat (/), per-node who-is-here chips, facepile with project labels; terminal co-attach (shared tmux, typing badge, no locking); canvas edits sync live and converge; Used n/N + per-device removal cuts seat immediately. sources.title: Relay quota & Pro
sources.locator: Free tier; What is never metered; Pro
sources.finding: Off-network phone/peer access runs E2E-encrypted through vendor relay; free tier = 5 relay bridges/month (per device per day, resets monthly, declined when out, notified as used); QR pairing and LAN connections never metered; Pro = unlimited bridges + Team Access by seat; compare/manage in Settings → License.

sources.title: Terminal persistence
sources.locator: tmux under the hood; Scrolling, selection, copy; Across app restarts; Across reboots
sources.finding: Each terminal runs in persistent tmux session nt-<node-id> on nodeterm socket/generated config (user tmux conf untouched); wheel/copy via tmux + OSC 52 (remote needs tmux >= 3.2); quit = detach, relaunch = warm reattach; reboot = cold restore: 256 KB/scrollback snapshot replay with separator + resumable-agent relaunch (claude --resume, codex resume, gemini --resume, opencode --session); node close (×) kills session permanently.

sources.title: Canvas & nodes
sources.locator: The canvas; Working with nodes; The hover guard; Context menus; Undo
sources.finding: Infinite pan/zoom canvas; node headers (collapse/color/rename/AI-name/tags/close with tmux-kill confirm); hover guard (~600 ms) keeps gestures out of shells; right-click menus; per-project layout undo (moves/edits/grouping; never reaches shells).

sources.title: Projects
sources.locator: One canvas per project; Opening folders; Closing vs deleting; Sharing a canvas via git
sources.finding: One canvas/tab per folder; <cwd>/.nodeterm/project.json is source of truth (portable, hot-reloaded, newer/content conflict bar); Close detaches (sessions keep running, Recently closed reattaches); only the Recently-closed × permanently tears down tmux sessions.

sources.finding: Seven node kinds: terminal (tmux+xterm), agent (terminal + agent CLI + header tracking), sticky, group (adopts children, binds worktrees), editor, read-only diff, SDK-driven Claude chat.

sources.title: FAQ

sources.title: Privacy Policy
sources.locator: Sections 1-10: collection, network calls, remote access, local storage, licensing
sources.finding: No accounts; terminal/code/prompt/transcript/SSH content never collected (only in-transit notification text passes push server, unstored); no analytics/crash SDKs (Android: FCM + ML Kit only); desktop update check + /v1/check (deviceId, version, OS/arch, plan, open-project count) always on; telemetry ping (deviceId, version, OS/arch) on-by-default, off via Settings or DO_NOT_TRACK/NODETERM_TELEMETRY_DISABLED; Pro binds deviceId via Stripe; relay E2EE (NaCl box) with metadata visible; keys in OS keychain/Keychain/Keystore.
